items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: Raleigh? Yeah, Emile Raleigh. Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: Now this other band here, I'm wondering when that was with D.D. and Emile Barnes, who's the guitar player? I don't know. That's Emile, what's the name of D.D.?
Raleigh? Yeah, Emile Raleigh. Oh, yeah.
Is that Raleigh? Might be. It's something in there, I'm taking pictures of it. That boy used to stay around the corner by a big George place.
